label: Oshun system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses an Oshun locus that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Oshun branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual OsnA2 genes, OsnA2 proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Oshun locus, unresolved Oshun trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
